# GigaRoute AI

> GigaRoute AI is manufacturing-logistics (AMHS) simulation software. GRS (GigaRoute Script) is the script language used for Model Logic in GR Simulation Studio.

## Current GRS reference

- [Help index](https://gigaroute.ai/help/): 135 GRS reference entries
- [Complete reference in Markdown](https://gigaroute.ai/help/syntax.md)
- [Structured reference (JSON)](https://gigaroute.ai/help/reference.json)

- [Humanoid](https://gigaroute.ai/help/humanoid.html)
